Bare text followed by a paragraph inside a blockquote gets a blank-line separator instead of merging into one line

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<blockquote>Just text, then <p>a paragraph</p></blockquote>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
